query: The Regulars' Table {The big round table at Mabel's belongs to the village regulars, four old friends, a box of dominoes and fifty years of arguments. They wave you over. "Settle something for us."|The regulars wave you over again. Today's dispute is about the academy in their day, when, they say, the stairs moved twice as often.|The regulars have saved you a chair. They've started calling you "the referee".} {The dominoes are clicking.|One of them was a student at the castle sixty years ago, and won't let anyone forget it.|{season == "winter": The window behind them is fogged from the teapots.|Mabel brings them more tea without being asked.}} Join the domino game {You win a whole crown off a retired miller who swears he let you. He didn't.|You win, and the old student declares that the academy has gone soft and been lucky. You'll take it.|You win, and the regulars demand a rematch next time. "The referee's been practising."} {The retired miller cleans you out with a smile like a closing door.|You lose to a woman of ninety who plays with her eyes shut.|You lose, and the regulars toast your generosity. Mabel brings you a consolation biscuit.} Listen to their stories {You hear about the year a professor turned the refectory into a pond by accident, and the year someone taught the stairs to waltz. Half of it might be true.|The old student describes the castle as it was: the same stairs, different shoes. It's strange to hear your life told back sixty years early.|You referee three arguments and hear four stories. Your tea goes cold. It's worth it.}

results.title: Your Cup on the Hook
results.excerpt:
Your Cup on the Hook
Behind Mabel's counter is a row of hooks with cups on them, each painted with a letter. You've never asked whose they are. Today, while you watch, Mabel hangs a new one with your initial on it. "Regulars," she says, as if that settled it.
